notes.title: Space Mercenary Shooter Episode 1 & 2 Major News Update
notes.content: Start off the new year with some excitement! Space Mercenary Shooter Episode 1 & 2 will be available to play completely free of charge beginning in January 2023.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Update 1.2 brings a variety of updates and bug fixes to the game.
One of the major goals of this update was increasing game stability/performance.
A summary of some of the changes can be found below.

Graphical changes
-Tweaked camera filters and post-processing effects.
-Re-textured Various objects
-Re-modled Turrets and various other small objects.
-New Lighting system
-UI Improvements to menu / in-game
-HUD enlarged and background added

Gameplay Changes
-Shrunk shotgun spread
-Slowed enemy projectiles
- Crosshairs better reflect actual weapon spread
- Enemy placement re-balance in some levels.


Performance
-Framerate Increases
-More stable on levels with large amounts of light objects.
-Improved Culling system
